name: Clione no Kimochi -Oshiete, Sensei Osanazuma-
original_name: クリオネの気持ち－おしえて、先生 おさな妻－
source:
Somewhere on the Darkside of the Moon, Second Lieutenant Fernandez and his all-female pilot squad are fighting for their lives against overwhelming forces. The XEN-TRIX mobile suit is technologically superior, but even cutting edge technology doesn't count for too much if you are outnumbered twenty to one.
Inevitably, a well placed shot inflicts critical damage, and Fernandez falls into a dark oblivion of wild memories...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在月球暗面的某个地方，费尔南德斯少尉和他的全女性飞行员小队正在与压倒性的力量战斗，为自己的生命而战。XEN-TRIX机动战士在技术上非常先进，但如果你的人数比是二十比一，那么即使是最先进的技术也没有多大意义。
不可避免地，一次恰到好处的射击会造成严重伤害，费尔南德斯陷入狂野记忆的黑暗遗忘之中……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
